name: Fuentepiñel (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue with the white hoist third, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Fuentepiñel (a fountain on red, a pine on white and ears of wheat on blue).
history: Fuentepiñel adopted its arms and flag officially on 30 May 2001, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 12 June 2001; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two vertical stripes in the proportions 1/3 and 2/3.
